name: A Warden of the Alliance

meta.previous: You Scream, I Scream... (Alliance), Let's Go Fly a Kite (Alliance)

summary: A Warden of the Alliance is the heartfelt conclusion to Children's Week for Alliance adventurers guiding a young orphan through Stormwind. After showing Randis the wonders of the kingdom, the hero buys a rack of toy foam swords so the rest of the orphanage can join the fun before returning the boy to Matron Nightingale.

sections.title: A Farewell Gift
sections.body: Throughout Children's Week, adventurers volunteer to take an orphan out into the world, offering a brief escape from the quiet walls of the Stormwind Orphanage. As his journey comes to an end, the young human orphan Randis realizes how lucky he has been compared to the friends he left behind. Rather than asking for one last treat for himself, his final wish is to bring something back for everyone: a foam sword rack purchased from Craggle Wobbletop, the traveling toy vendor patrolling the Canals outside the Trade District.

sections.title: Joy in the Cathedral Square
sections.body: Returning to the Cathedral District, the adventurer delivers Randis back to Orphan Matron Nightingale along with the toys. The gift transforms the quiet steps of the orphanage into a lively playground as children pour outside to grab foam blades and stage mock battles across the courtyard. Grateful for the kindness shown to Randis, Matron Nightingale honors the adventurer as a true warden of the Alliance and presents a small pet chosen by the boy to remember his week in the wider world.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this quest?
aliases: what do you do in a warden of the alliance
warden of the alliance quest goal
faq.answer: This quest marks the finale of Children's Week for Alliance players. You purchase a Foam Sword Rack from the toy vendor Craggle Wobbletop in Stormwind's Canals and return Randis to Orphan Matron Nightingale at the Cathedral District orphanage.

Randis is a young human boy residing in the Stormwind Orphanage who accompanies Alliance adventurers during Children's Week. Having lost his parents, he spends the holiday seeing sights across the Alliance before returning home.

faq.q: Where can Craggle Wobbletop be found?
faq.answer: Craggle Wobbletop is a gnome toy merchant who walks along the paved paths of the Canals bordering the Trade District in Stormwind City, pushing a cart stocked with novelties.

faq.q: What happens when the quest is turned in?
faq.answer: When you deliver the Foam Sword Rack to Orphan Matron Nightingale, the rack is set down and the children rush out from the orphanage, grabbing foam swords and play-fighting across the courtyard.

Orphan Matron Nightingale is the caretaker of the Stormwind Orphanage in the Cathedral District. She oversees the welfare of children left parentless by the Third War and other ongoing conflicts threatening the kingdom.

faq.q: Why does Randis ask for foam swords?
faq.answer: Randis is grateful for the adventures he experienced and feels sympathy for the children who had to stay behind. He wants all of his fellow orphans to share in the fun of Children's Week with toys of their own.

angles.text: The quest embodies the spirit of the Alliance's defenders, reminding champions that protecting the kingdom means looking after its most vulnerable survivors.
For humans of Stormwind, caring for the city's war orphans hits close to home after years of fighting the Scourge, gnolls, and the Defias Brotherhood.
Guiding an orphan and bringing joy to the children outside the Cathedral of Light reflects the holy duty of compassion central to the Silver Hand.
